name: low-value-2026-09
note: A custom rule for short throwaway remarks, bare quote or headline reposts, 🚨 announcements, growth hacks and unsupported hot takes. Tuned on 36 review labels; see docs/rule-tuning-2026-09.md.

rules.label: 低价值水帖
rules.include: Is this post low-value — a short throwaway remark, a bare quote or headline repost, a sensational "🚨 breaking" announcement, a growth-hack or virality tip, an aphorism, or a hot take asserted without any evidence — so that a reader learns nothing specific and new from it?
rules.exclude: the post reports concrete numbers, first-hand experience, technical detail, or a multi-step argument with evidence the reader can check, or asks a genuine question
